notablePrerequisites: You do not control an Elf or Druid, or have an Elf or Druid card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Deep Forest Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Volo triggers, copying the Deep Forest Hermit spell.
Resolve the copy of the Deep Forest Hermit spell.
When the token Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the original Deep Forest Hermit spell.
When the nontoken Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing the Deep Forest Hermit token and six Squirrels, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deep Forest Hermit to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
